title: Singular negative questions: Eikö tämä ole…?
summary: Build singular negative yes/no questions with eikö and ole.
objectives: Begin a singular negative question with eikö.
Place the supplied subject before ole.
Keep both parts of the negative question construction.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: A singular negative yes/no question begins with Eikö.
Eikö contains the negative verb ei and the front-vowel question suffix -kö.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: The subject follows, and ole appears later as the main verb.
Keep both eikö and ole in the complete question.

steps: tämä avain: the complete subject is supplied.
tuo avain: the complete subject is supplied.

examples.english: Isn't the previously identified key here?
steps: se avain: the complete subject is supplied.

commonMistakes: Do not use eivätkö with a singular subject.

practiceExercises.explanation: Eikö carries singular negative agreement and -ko/-kö; ole follows later in the question.

optionFeedback.Eikö se auto ole täällä?: Correct. Eikö carries singular negative agreement and -ko/-kö; ole follows later in the question.
optionFeedback.Eivätkö se auto ole täällä?: “Eivätkö” is the plural negative question verb; use “Eikö”, the singular negative question verb.
“Ei” is the singular negative verb; use “Eikö”, the singular negative question verb.
optionFeedback.Onko se auto täällä?: “Onko” is the singular affirmative question verb; use “Eikö”, the singular negative question verb.
